csat.purpose: Own the versioned transactional-CSAT contract for Customer Feedback: survey kind and version identity, the stable workflow/outcome-code allow-list, the source-context outcome-fact schema, sampling-policy metadata, the invitation shape with its versioned lifecycle event contracts, the CSAT and response-rate calculation, and the legacy-experience-rating classification.
expectedConsumers: Customer Feedback invitation, recording, and analytics leaves

runtime-support.purpose: Provide the Customer Feedback event-store base schema and runtime service composition seam for the invitation aggregate and CSAT projection leaves.

routes.purpose: Reserve Customer Feedback route metadata for the future csat invitation, survey, and operator page route contributions.
